in_marathi.name: Harshvardhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Harshest, Cruelest, or Most Valiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harshvardhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Harshvardhan is derived from two Sanskrit words: Harsh (harsham) and Vardhan (vardhayati). Harsh means 'harsh, cruel, or severe,' while Vardhan means 'nourisher, sustainer, or one who strengthens.' In Hindu mythology, the name Harshvardhan is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is known to have both harsh and merciful aspects. He is believed to be the sustainer of the universe and the provider of spiritual nourishment.
